= KYAML conformance fixtures

`Hypatia.Kyaml` (`lib/hypatia/kyaml.ex`) is an Elixir port of kyq's
reference KYAML parser, `metadatastician/kyq` `conformance/src/kyaml.js`.
kyq is the canonical reader; these files hold the port to it.

`corpus/`::
  kyq's conformance corpus (`conformance/fixtures/kyaml/`, `cases.json`), copied
  from kyq `4d1071df04d93e089500d58d0b6ba37bfcc75248` plus three fixtures from the kyq
  fix listed in `KNOWN_DIVERGENCES.adoc` (`flow-trailing-comma.yaml` stays as kyq
  has it, and the test lists it as read differently). `test/kyaml_conformance_test.exs`
  holds every case to its pinned outcome: a valid fixture parses into the
  pinned number of documents, and an invalid one fails with the pinned code,
  line, column and pointer path. Refresh it by copying kyq's directory over
  this one, and update the commit above.

`kyq_dump.mjs`::
  Prints kyq's parse of each file in the canonical form `Hypatia.Kyaml.canonical/1`
  gives: every node's kind, line, column and value, aliases seen through. It is
  kyq's side of the differential.

== The differential

The `kyaml-conformance` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` checks out kyq at
`KYQ_REF`, dumps kyq's own fixtures and every workflow in this repository,
and runs `test/kyaml_differential_test.exs`. Locally:

[source,bash]
----
ln -s ../kyq .kyq    # the dumper reads kyq from .kyq, as CI checks it out
bun test/fixtures/kyaml/kyq_dump.mjs .kyq/conformance/fixtures/kyaml/*/*.yaml .github/workflows/*.yml > /tmp/kyq.jsonl
KYQ_DUMP=/tmp/kyq.jsonl mix test --only kyq_differential
----

Measured when the port landed:

* kyq's corpus and the 185 workflows of hypatia, standards, rsr-template-repo,
  choreographic-types and kyq: 231 of 231 files agree;
* 10,000 mutated files (two seeds, up to four edits each, over kyq's valid
  fixtures and estate workflows; 27 distinct error codes exercised): all agree
  once kyq's three bugs below are fixed. Before that, the mutations found the
  third one.
